evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep skips straight into availability check and date confirmation with no time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote. No wait for customer agreement before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing ('So first is your requested date') without soliciting customer's concerns or what they want answers to.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Danah provides typical range for full 1200 sq ft (6-8 hours) and personalizes to this customer's partial move (2.5 hour minimum, $510-$714 for two movers).
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Danah asks 'does that seem fair?' and customer responds 'Okay. Yup, that sounds good' — silence is held and respected.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep moves directly to 'So I'll go ahead and lock in Saturday October 3rd for you' — assumes the sale rather than asking 'Would you like our help with your move?'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Danah confirms date (Saturday October 3rd afternoon), arrival window (1-4 PM), crew size (two movers), and starting address (4028 Center Street). Destination address and notes about customer concerns are missing.

top_strength: Danah effectively gathered detailed inventory (two TVs, furniture list, queen bed, dresser, desk, garage items) through patient item-by-item follow-up, ensuring an accurate move estimate.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Concerns) was completely skipped — start every call by asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before diving into logistics, and Section 5 (Two Promises) was entirely missing, so the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage were never mentioned.
